samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo paridevo ādevanā paridevanā ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave paridevo. katamañca bhikkhave dukkhaṃ. yaṃ kho bhikkhave mn10:48.0: tassudānaṃ ajaraṃ amaraṃ amatādhigamaṃ phalamagganidassanaṃ dukkhanudaṃ sahitatthamahārahassakaraṃ
mn10:48.1: bahupītiharaṃ vividhaṃ suṇātha taḷākāva supūritaṃ ghammapathe
mn10:48.2: tividhaggisilesitanibbānaṃ byādhipanodanaopadayo majjhimasuttavarā ṭhapitā madhumaddavamandarasā amarānaṃ khiḍḍaratijananī
mn10:48.3: manusaṅghaṃ taṃ suttabyākaraṇañca ṭhapitā sakyaputtānmābhiramattā tipaññāsavaraṃ
mn10:48.4: diyaḍḍhasataṃ dve ca veyyākaraṇaṃ apare ca te asame pathavaggavagge anupubbena ekamanā nisāmetha mūdaggaṃ mūlaāsavadhammadāyāda- bheravanaṅgaṇakaṅkhasuttaṃ vatthasallekhadiṭṭhisati pathavaggavaro so samatto.
